description: Weekly U.S. Drought Monitor drought-severity statistics for one U.S. state or territory: percent of area or percent of population in categories None, D0 (abnormally dry) through D4 (exceptional drought). Categories are cumulative (D1+ means D1 through D4 combined). Published weekly — map valid every Tuesday, released the following Thursday. Omit dates for the latest available map.

end_date.description: Latest map date, YYYY-MM-DD or M/D/YYYY. Omit for the latest single map.

measure.description: 'area' = percent of land area in each category (default). 'population' = percent of the state's population in each category.

start_date.description: Earliest map date, YYYY-MM-DD or M/D/YYYY. Omit for the latest single map.

state.description: State or territory name, two-letter postal abbreviation, or two-digit FIPS code, e.g. 'Texas', 'TX', or '48'.

name: us_drought_state
title: Us Drought State
